chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام said:
"Whoever completes the recitation of the Qur'an in Makkah will not die until he sees the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and sees his place in Paradise."

key_terms.الْجَنَّةِ: Paradise, the abode of divine reward
key_terms.الْقُرْآنَ: the Qur'an, the divine revelation being recited
key_terms.بِمَكَّةَ: in Makkah, the sacred sanctuary and place of pilgrimage
key_terms.خَتَمَ: completed fully, especially the recitation of the entire Qur'an
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم

ai.seo_question: What is the virtue of completing the Qur'an in Makkah according to Imam ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith speaks of the great virtue of completing the recitation of the Qur'an in Makkah. It promises that such a person will, before death, see the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and behold his place in Paradise.
